title: Remote author checks
summary: An opt-in pilot sends a named solution build from a running coding session to spare KORI capacity using a fenced snapshot and a model-free wait. An advisory receipt and card log identify the checked source.

openDecisions.title: Snapshot transfer
openDecisions.question: How should the unfinished source reach the execution host?

options.A: Publish a fenced, expiring check ref

openDecisions.recommendation: B. Send a lease-scoped Git bundle
openDecisions.rationale: The Task Server can grant access to one immutable source artifact and expire it without remote repository writes.

openDecisions.title: Execution plane
openDecisions.question: Which claim mechanism should carry author checks?

options.A: Specialize a review attempt without aspects
options.C: Add an author-check kind using post-work claim mechanics

openDecisions.recommendation: C. Add an author-check kind using post-work claim mechanics
openDecisions.rationale: Post-work mechanics already support bounded execution without a model and can host a distinct advisory receipt.

openDecisions.title: Protected capacity
openDecisions.question: How much capacity should the pilot use?

options.A: One KORI slot with review and gate priority, a reserve and hard request limits
options.C: Equal admission priority with reviews and gates

openDecisions.recommendation: A. One KORI slot with review and gate priority, a reserve and hard request limits
openDecisions.rationale: A single slot uses spare capacity while the shared host budget and admission reserve protect delivery work.

openDecisions.title: Check contract
openDecisions.question: Which inputs and results should the check accept?

options.A: Approved named checks, one exact test class and five-minute receipt reuse
options.C: Full plan only, without filters or reuse

openDecisions.recommendation: A. Approved named checks, one exact test class and five-minute receipt reuse
openDecisions.rationale: The plan identifies what ran and lets repeated requests reuse the same bounded, comparable result.

openDecisions.title: Routing policy
openDecisions.question: Who should decide where the check runs?

options.A: Explicit remote selection in the pilot, measured routing after the pilot
options.C: Send all named checks to the least loaded eligible host

openDecisions.recommendation: A. Explicit remote selection in the pilot, measured routing after the pilot
openDecisions.rationale: An explicit pilot establishes real cost. Measured routing preserves fast local feedback as host load changes.

openDecisions.title: Result authority
openDecisions.question: Should a check receipt count toward release verification?

options.A: Author feedback with independent review and gate evidence
options.B: Reuse a matching pass as review verification

openDecisions.recommendation: A. Author feedback with independent review and gate evidence
openDecisions.rationale: An unfinished attempt requests author feedback. Release evidence has separate subject provenance and authority.

implementationTasks.title: Prove one remote solution build
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Prove one remote solution build

Read AGENTS.md and docs/remote-author-checks/index.html (AGT-4428). Use the recommendations for the cited decisions unless the recorded owner selection differs. Record the implemented options and evidence.

Scope: AC-D1 to AC-D6 for one active Agent Studio coding attempt on agent-runner-01 and one capability-enabled KORI executor. Inspect the delivered AGT-4381 command and AGT-4382 wait behavior. Reuse them where available. Keep a single blocking command seam compatible with their interfaces if either is still in flight, and coordinate the change before editing their owned paths.

Implement a disabled-by-default end-to-end path for one approved named solution build. The platform runner captures a dirty-tree snapshot with a temporary Git index and uploads a bounded bundle. Verify parent authority before registration, verified immutable source before build, and both fences for settlement. Use the existing post-work claim and grant mechanics for a distinct author-check kind with a dedicated receipt. Use a fresh bounded container through the KORI host identity and approved prewarmed base. Provide one reserved pilot slot, expiry, one concurrent request, server-side hourly caps, request-id replay protection and gate/review priority. Enable only for the specified project, source attempt and authorized host when protected work facts are fresh. Run one remote build without provider login. Return at most 20 lines and the durable card log. Disable the pilot via its opt-in and drain its child claim. Keep the general plan and routing work for later slices.

Acceptance: From an authorized session on the server, show a dirty source change that exists only in the bundle, a single KORI build of that exact tree with exit and card log, elapsed time and bytes, and zero model calls in the blocked interval. Show red build output on a distinct tree and reject a stale parent or wrong bundle digest before commands. Check that concurrent replay of the same request starts one execution and that source staging and container resources are reclaimed. Check that no review, gate, lane or delivery-ref mutation occurred. Supply real two-host evidence alongside deterministic failure and authority tests. Use the normal deployment and operator authorization path for that proof.

implementationTasks.title: Extend the named check contract
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Extend the named check contract

Read AGENTS.md and docs/remote-author-checks/index.html (AGT-4428). Use the recommendations for the cited decisions unless the recorded owner selection differs. Record the implemented options and evidence.

Scope: AC-D4 and AC-D6 in the check command, plan resolver and test adapters. Use the input and receipt envelope from pilot. Add approved names for the project's preparation, build, test and lint where supported. Pin the plan and execution profile digests. Provide one exact fully qualified test class as a typed selector, an execution timeout only within plan bounds, and an explicit remote selection. Validate filter matching, produce a clear error for no tests, report the steps actually run, and format diagnostics within 20 lines with stable artifact paths. Preserve local calls and the AGT-4382 blocking wait. Coordinate with authority using the pilot envelope so this slice can work in the command/plan layer only.

Acceptance: Run named build, test, class-filtered test and lint through the relevant normal entry points. Prove invalid names and filters cannot supply argv or environment controls. Prove distinct keys for plan, filter, timeout and profile changes. Verify timeout and failing output summaries, and that pass or fail has no release authority.

implementationTasks.title: Harden check admission and retention
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Harden check admission and retention

Read AGENTS.md and docs/remote-author-checks/index.html (AGT-4428). Use the recommendations for the cited decisions unless the recorded owner selection differs. Record the implemented options and evidence.

Scope: AC-D1, AC-D2, AC-D3 and AC-D6 in Task Server and the host execution adapter. Keep the pilot command envelope stable. Generalize its single permitted build to approved typed plans through that envelope. Make parent and child fencing, cancellation, idempotency and cleanup restart-safe. Coalesce equivalent pending work and reuse eligible completed receipts for five minutes. Apply the per-card and project rolling-hour caps atomically and enforce separate staged-input limits. Count the grant against physical host load across the three review adapters and the SSH gate bridge. Verify protected-work reservation for newly arriving gates and reviews and fail closed on stale capacity. Use the orchestration decision library for transitions in line with its contract. Keep import, run, artifact access, bounded cleanup, and logs tied to the correct grant and owner.

Acceptance: Exercise concurrent equal and distinct keys, cap boundaries, oldest eligible ordering, unavailable and timeout, lost parent and child fences, shutdown and restart, orphan expiry, and stale artifact reads. Demonstrate shared KORI admission with simultaneous real review and bridge-gate demand or a faithful deterministic fixture. Prove that late reports and author receipts are inert to review, gate and integration. Supply grant and cleanup evidence.

implementationTasks.title: Measure the pilot and add opt-in routing
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Measure the pilot and add opt-in routing

Read AGENTS.md and docs/remote-author-checks/index.html (AGT-4428). Use the recommendations for the cited decisions unless the recorded owner selection differs. Record the implemented options and evidence.

Scope: AC-D3 and AC-D5 in the named check front door. Preserve an explicit remote selection, start outside the pilot disabled, and default to local for incremental single-project builds, single-file tests and missing history. Add opt-in measured routing for eligible, expensive named checks using live admission and the Dossier timing rule. Keep forced remote unavailable distinct from an explicit local retry. Record paired timing and CPU evidence by load and cache band, queue and transfer cost, protected work claim latency and counts of actual replaced local invocations. Reuse existing telemetry sinks where they support the required non-secret fields.

Acceptance: Show route choices with fresh and stale timing or capacity, thresholds at their boundaries and no duplicate launch on fallback or retry. Compare a same-state local/remote pilot on KORI and report p50/p90 when the sample supports them. Keep broader rollout off unless the measured time benefit and protected-work latency criteria hold. Document the pilot results as measured, including sample size and any missing attribution.
